nav.d: Ramadan, Eid and holidays for every branch in one edit

seo.title: Bulk & Ramadan Hours for All Branches | SAAYT
seo.description: Change opening hours across every branch on Google Maps in one step and schedule Ramadan and Eid hours from ready templates before the season starts

h1: Every branch shows the right hours in every season
lead: Set Ramadan, Eid and holiday hours once and apply them to the branches you choose. SAAYT flags any branch that is missing its season hours before a customer arrives at a closed door

why.h2: Why hours matter more than you think

items.d: Many people look up a branch and check whether it is open now before heading out
Late-night opening and split shifts differ by branch and that is where most mistakes happen

items.t: A closed branch means a bad review
items.d: A customer who finds the door locked often writes about it on Google the same day
Ramadan, both Eids, National Day and Founding Day templates you edit once and reuse every year
Pick branches by city or type and apply hours to all of them in one step
A morning shift and an evening or post-Taraweeh shift for every branch
Before the season SAAYT shows which branches still have no special hours
See the new hours per branch and approve them before they reach Google
Special hours have a start and end date and then each branch returns to its regular hours

steps.d: Choose the season hours and the start and end dates
All branches, one city or only mall branches
Check each branch, approve and it goes to Google

guard.d: Nothing reaches a branch profile on Google until an authorised person on your team approves it

faq.q: Can one branch keep different hours?
faq.a: Yes. The template is a starting point and you can adjust any branch before approving
Special hours carry an end date and each branch returns to its regular hours automatically
Yes. Mark a branch as open all day or closed on a specific day such as the first day of Eid
